answer: The price of trying is 35 separate visits, each one billed £83 at the door, paid up front for every single name, while the spiral stays small. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every entry must show Beltbound cowhide dresser tawer writ before the ledger opens, because a writ cowhide dressers sign after dressing yard checks. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The tally keeps pearl. The clerk notes marble.
